description: The Global Configuration keys the Task Broker reads (architecture §2.3, implementation §1.2.5). Durations are integers in milliseconds.

auction_timeout.description: How long the Task Broker waits for proposals on a task.announced before declaring the task vacant, in milliseconds (architecture §3.7.5, step 5).

preconditions.message: auction_timeout has to be less than hitl_response_window (architecture §3.5.2)

reannounce_backoff_base.description: The initial interval between successive re-announcements of the same task, in milliseconds; it doubles on each one up to max_reannounce_backoff (architecture §3.1).

max_reannounce_backoff.description: The ceiling of the re-announcement interval, in milliseconds (architecture §3.1).

task_lease_ttl.description: How long the Task Broker tolerates receiving no renewal from the assignee before returning the task to UNASSIGNED, in milliseconds (architecture §3.1).

similarity_precision_decimals.description: The decimals a similarity is rounded to before comparing it against a floor and before deciding a tie (architecture §3.7.5, step 4).

network_admission.description: The network's admission state, which the Task Broker reads before granting any assignment (architecture §3.18).

preconditions.message: the network opens only with embedding_model assigned (architecture §2.3, §3.18)
